exampleTransliteration: In rāz rā be kasi nagu.
exampleEnglish: Don't tell this secret to anyone.
I have complete trust in him/her.
Patience is the key to success.
His/her room is full of order.
Disorder in the work caused problems.
He/she has a lot of responsibility.
He/she has the right to choose.
He/she didn't have permission to enter.
The world is full of beauty.
The universe is big and amazing.

exampleFarsi: علم فیزیک قوانین طبیعت را بررسی می‌کند.
exampleTransliteration: Elm-e fizik qavānin-e tabi'at rā barresi mikonad.
exampleEnglish: Physics studies the laws of nature.

exampleFarsi: زیست‌شناسی موجودات زنده را مطالعه می‌کند.
exampleTransliteration: Zist-shenāsi mojudāt-e zende rā motāle'e mikonad.

exampleEnglish: The nature of this region is beautiful.

exampleFarsi: باید از محیط زیست محافظت کنیم.
exampleTransliteration: Bāyad az mohit-e zist mohāfezat konim.

exampleEnglish: Air pollution is a big problem.

exampleFarsi: این ماشین انرژی زیادی مصرف می‌کند.
exampleTransliteration: In māshin enerzhi-ye ziyādi masraf mikonad.
exampleEnglish: This machine consumes a lot of energy.

exampleFarsi: آب و هوای اینجا معتدل است.
exampleTransliteration: Āb o havā-ye injā mo'tadel ast.

exampleFarsi: این کار غیرممکن به نظر می‌رسید.
exampleTransliteration: In kār qeyr-e momken be nazar miresid.

exampleEnglish: This book is necessary for me.

exampleFarsi: او در مدرسه خصوصی درس می‌خواند.
exampleTransliteration: U dar madrese-ye khosusi dars mikhānad.
exampleEnglish: He/she studies at a private school.

exampleFarsi: این مسیر خطرناک و عجیب بود.
exampleTransliteration: In masir khatarnāk o ajib bud.
exampleEnglish: This path was dangerous and strange.

exampleFarsi: این دو خواهر خیلی شبیه هم هستند.
exampleTransliteration: In do khāhar kheyli shabih-e ham hastand.
exampleEnglish: These two sisters are very similar.

exampleFarsi: این فرش دستی بافته شده است.
exampleTransliteration: In farsh-e dasti bāfte shode ast.

exampleFarsi: شهر ترکیبی از قدیم و جدید است.
exampleTransliteration: Shahr tarkibi az qadim o jadid ast.
exampleEnglish: The city is a mix of old and new.
He/she didn't say the main reason.
We took an overall look at the topic.
He/she was sure of his/her decision.
He/she was uncertain about the future.

exampleFarsi: او در باشگاه خیلی فعال است.
exampleTransliteration: U dar bāshgāh kheyli fa'āl ast.
exampleEnglish: He/she is very active at the gym.
Dead leaves were on the ground.
These shoes have become worn out.
The bread had become a bit hard.
The road was flat and comfortable.
He/she drew a circle on the paper.
The size of the dress was suitable.
The depth of the sea is great.

exampleFarsi: طول این میز دو متر است.
exampleTransliteration: Tul-e in miz do metr ast.
exampleEnglish: The length of this table is two meters.
The width of the room is small.
The book was in the corner of the room.
The edge of the table was sharp.
We reached the end of the street.
Water was bubbling from the spring.

exampleFarsi: سرنوشت او را به این شهر کشاند.
exampleTransliteration: Sarnevesht u rā be in shahr keshānd.
exampleEnglish: Fate brought him/her to this city.

exampleFarsi: او استعداد زیادی در موسیقی دارد.
exampleTransliteration: U este'dād-e ziyādi dar musiqi dārad.
exampleEnglish: He/she has a great talent for music.
His pride prevented him from apologizing.

exampleFarsi: بعد از شکست به انزوا رفت.
exampleTransliteration: Ba'd az shekast be enzavā raft.
exampleEnglish: After the failure, he withdrew into isolation.

exampleFarsi: سرزندگی او همه را شگفت‌زده کرد.
exampleTransliteration: Sarzendegi-ye u hame rā shegeft-zade kard.

exampleFarsi: اندوهی سنگین بر دلش نشسته بود.
exampleTransliteration: Andoohi-ye sangin bar delesh neshaste bood.
exampleEnglish: A heavy grief had settled over his heart.
He/she longed regretfully for bygone days.

exampleFarsi: شنیدن آن موسیقی او را به وجد آورد.
exampleTransliteration: Shenidan-e ān musiqi u rā be vajd āvord.
exampleEnglish: Hearing that music brought him to a state of rapture.

exampleFarsi: ملال زندگی روزمره او را فرسوده بود.
exampleTransliteration: Malāl-e zendegi-ye ruzmarre-ye u rā farsude bud.
exampleEnglish: The melancholy of daily life had worn him down.

exampleFarsi: شعر او رنگ و بویی از عرفان دارد.
exampleTransliteration: She'r-e u rang o bu-yi az erfān dārad.
exampleEnglish: His poetry carries a hint of mysticism.

exampleFarsi: او در برابر سرنوشت تسلیم شد.
exampleTransliteration: U dar barābar-e sarnevesht taslim shod.

exampleFarsi: شاعر در پی جاودانگی از طریق کلمات بود.
exampleTransliteration: Shā'er dar peye jāvedānegi az tariq-e kalamāt bud.
exampleEnglish: The poet sought immortality through words.

exampleFarsi: شکوه کاخ همه را مبهوت کرد.
exampleTransliteration: Shokuh-e kākh hame rā mabhut kard.
exampleEnglish: The splendor of the palace astonished everyone.

exampleFarsi: زندگی پر از رمز و راز است.
exampleTransliteration: Zendegi por az ramz o rāz ast.

exampleFarsi: با تدبیر مشکل را حل کرد.
exampleTransliteration: Bā tadbir moshkel rā hall kard.
exampleEnglish: He solved the problem with prudence.

exampleFarsi: شیفتگی او به موسیقی عمیق بود.
exampleTransliteration: Shiftegi-ye u be musiqi amiq bud.
exampleEnglish: His fascination with music ran deep.

exampleFarsi: دلتنگی برای خانواده‌اش او را رنج می‌داد.
exampleTransliteration: Deltangi barāye khānevāde-ash u rā ranj midād.
exampleEnglish: Longing for his family caused him pain.

exampleFarsi: سکوت اتاق را پر کرده بود.
exampleTransliteration: Sokut otāq rā por karde bud.

exampleFarsi: فروتنی او همه را تحت تأثیر قرار داد.
exampleTransliteration: Forutani-ye u hame rā tahte ta'sir qarār dād.

exampleFarsi: عناد او باعث شکست مذاکرات شد.
exampleTransliteration: Enād-e u bā'es-e shekast-e mozākerāt shod.
exampleEnglish: His obstinacy caused the negotiations to fail.
The resonance of his voice echoed through the hall.

exampleFarsi: شیدایی او نسبت به هنر مثال‌زدنی بود.
exampleTransliteration: Sheydāyi-ye u nesbat be honar mesāl-zadani bud.
exampleEnglish: His infatuation with art was exemplary.

exampleFarsi: نگون‌بختی او را از پا درنیاورد.
exampleTransliteration: Negun-bakhti u rā az pā dar-nayāvord.
exampleEnglish: Misfortune did not bring him down.

exampleFarsi: او در جستجوی رهایی از رنج بود.
exampleTransliteration: U dar jostoju-ye rahāyi az ranj bud.
exampleEnglish: He was searching for liberation from suffering.

exampleFarsi: افسون آن شهر او را مجذوب کرد.
exampleTransliteration: Afsun-e ān shahr u rā majzub kard.
exampleEnglish: The enchantment of that city captivated him.
War caused the ruin of the city.

exampleFarsi: شکیبایی او در سختی‌ها ستودنی بود.
exampleTransliteration: Shakibāyi-ye u dar sakhti-hā setudani bud.
exampleEnglish: His endurance through hardships was admirable.

exampleFarsi: بی‌قراری او را از خواب انداخت.
exampleTransliteration: Biqarāri u rā az khāb andākht.
exampleEnglish: His restlessness kept him from sleep.
The loftiness of his thought shows in his writings.

exampleFarsi: سرشاری محبتش همه را گرم کرد.
exampleTransliteration: Sarshāri-ye mohabbatash hame rā garm kard.
exampleEnglish: The abundance of his affection warmed everyone.

exampleFarsi: پژمردگی گل‌ها نشانه پایان تابستان بود.
exampleTransliteration: Pazhmordegi-ye gol-hā neshāne-ye pāyān-e tābestān bud.
exampleEnglish: The withering of the flowers signaled summer's end.

exampleFarsi: موسیقی محفل را غرق طرب کرد.
exampleTransliteration: Musiqi mahfel rā qarq-e tarab kard.
exampleEnglish: The music filled the gathering with joy.

exampleFarsi: دلبستگی او به وطن عمیق بود.
exampleTransliteration: Delbastegi-ye u be vatan amiq bud.
exampleEnglish: His attachment to his homeland ran deep.

exampleFarsi: نیاز روحی او را به عرفان کشاند.
exampleTransliteration: Niyāz-e ruhi-ye u rā be erfān keshānd.
exampleEnglish: His spiritual need drew him to mysticism.

exampleFarsi: نقاشی او سرشار از تجرید بود.
exampleTransliteration: Naqqāshi-ye u sarshār az tajrid bud.
exampleEnglish: His painting was full of abstraction.
He sank into a deep trance.

exampleFarsi: گیرایی سخنانش حضار را مجذوب کرد.
exampleTransliteration: Girāyi-ye sokhanānash hozzār rā majzub kard.
exampleEnglish: The charisma of his speech captivated the audience.

exampleFarsi: او مردی والاگهر و بخشنده بود.
exampleTransliteration: U mardi vālā-gohar va bakhshande bud.
exampleEnglish: He was a noble-natured and generous man.

exampleFarsi: بازتاب نور در آب دیدنی بود.
exampleTransliteration: Bāztāb-e noor dar āb didani bud.
exampleEnglish: The reflection of light on the water was beautiful.

exampleFarsi: همنشینی با خردمندان انسان را متحول می‌کند.
exampleTransliteration: Hamneshini bā kheradmandān ensān rā motahavvel mikonad.
exampleEnglish: Companionship with the wise transforms a person.
The child's playful antics made everyone laugh.

exampleFarsi: او ساعت‌ها در تفکر فرو رفت.
exampleTransliteration: U sā'at-hā dar tafakkor foru raft.
exampleEnglish: He sank into contemplation for hours.

exampleFarsi: شب‌ها در لونه، روز‌ها به پرواز.
exampleTransliteration: Shab-hā dar loone, ruz-hā be parvāz.
exampleEnglish: Nights in the nest, days in flight.

exampleFarsi: او برای دفاع از خانواده‌اش غیرت نشان داد.
exampleTransliteration: U barāye defā' az khānevāde-ash gheyrat neshān dād.
exampleEnglish: He showed protective pride in defending his family.

exampleFarsi: او با وقار خاصی سخن می‌گفت.
exampleTransliteration: U bā vaghār-e khāssi sokhan miguft.
exampleEnglish: He spoke with a particular dignity.

exampleFarsi: تکبرش همه را از خود دور کرد.
exampleTransliteration: Takabbor-ash hame rā az khod dur kard.

exampleFarsi: تواضع او همه را تحت تأثیر قرار داد.
exampleTransliteration: Tavāzo'-e u hame rā tahte ta'sir qarār dād.

exampleFarsi: او با عشوه‌ای خاص لبخند زد.
exampleTransliteration: U bā eshve'i khāss labkhand zad.
exampleEnglish: She smiled with a particular coquetry.

exampleFarsi: نازک‌دلی او باعث می‌شد زود اشک بریزد.
exampleTransliteration: Nāzok-deli-ye u bā'es mishod zud ashk berizad.
exampleEnglish: Her tender-heartedness made her cry easily.

exampleFarsi: دلهره‌ی امتحان تمام شب او را بیدار نگه داشت.
exampleTransliteration: Delhore-ye emtehān tamām-e shab u rā bidār negah dāsht.
exampleEnglish: Exam anxiety kept him awake all night.

exampleFarsi: اضطراب شدیدی سراسر وجودش را گرفت.
exampleTransliteration: Ezterāb-e shadidi sarāsar-e vojudash rā gereft.
exampleEnglish: A severe anxiety overtook his whole being.

exampleFarsi: کنار دریا آرامش عجیبی احساس کردم.
exampleTransliteration: Kenār-e daryā ārāmesh-e ajibi ehsās kardam.
exampleEnglish: By the sea, I felt a strange calm.

exampleFarsi: او با همت فراوان به هدفش رسید.
exampleTransliteration: U bā hemmat-e farāvān be hadaf-ash resid.
exampleEnglish: He reached his goal with great determination.

exampleFarsi: شوق دیدار او روزها آرامم نمی‌گذاشت.
exampleTransliteration: Showq-e didār-e u ruz-hā ārām-am nemigozāsht.
exampleEnglish: The eagerness to see her gave me no peace for days.

exampleFarsi: از دیدن آن منظره در حیرت فرو رفت.
exampleTransliteration: Az didan-e ān manzareh dar heyrat foru raft.
exampleEnglish: He was struck with astonishment at the sight of that view.

exampleFarsi: اشتیاق او به یادگیری هرگز کم نشد.
exampleTransliteration: Eshtiyāq-e u be yādgiri hargez kam nashod.
exampleEnglish: His yearning to learn never diminished.

exampleFarsi: او سال‌ها کینه‌ی آن توهین را به دل داشت.
exampleTransliteration: U sāl-hā kine-ye ān towhin rā be del dāsht.
exampleEnglish: He held a grudge over that insult for years.

exampleFarsi: نفرت چیزی نیست که آرامش بیاورد.
exampleTransliteration: Nefrat chizi nist ke ārāmesh biyāvarad.
exampleEnglish: Hatred is not something that brings peace.

exampleFarsi: موفقیت او رشک همکارانش را برانگیخت.
exampleTransliteration: Movaffaghiyat-e u rashk-e hamkārān-ash rā barangikht.
exampleEnglish: His success provoked his colleagues' envy.

exampleFarsi: حسادت می‌تواند دوستی‌های قدیمی را از بین ببرد.
exampleTransliteration: Hasādat mitavānad dusti-hā-ye qadimi rā az beyn bebarad.

exampleFarsi: به زندگی آرام آن‌ها غبطه می‌خوردم.
exampleTransliteration: Be zendegi-ye ārām-e ānhā ghebteh mikhordam.

exampleFarsi: بخشش او نشانه‌ی بزرگی روحش بود.
exampleTransliteration: Bakhshesh-e u neshāne-ye bozorgi-ye ruh-ash bud.
exampleEnglish: His forgiveness was a sign of his great spirit.

exampleFarsi: گذشت او باعث آشتی دوباره‌شان شد.
exampleTransliteration: Gozasht-e u bā'es-e āshti-ye dobāreh-shān shod.
exampleEnglish: His forbearance led to their reconciliation.

exampleFarsi: صداقت او باعث اعتماد همه شد.
exampleTransliteration: Sedāqat-e u bā'es-e e'temād-e hame shod.

exampleFarsi: صمیمیت آن جمع فضا را دلپذیر کرده بود.
exampleTransliteration: Samimiyat-e ān jam' fazā rā delpazir karde bud.
exampleEnglish: The warmth of that gathering made the atmosphere pleasant.

exampleFarsi: وفاداری او به دوستانش زبانزد بود.
exampleTransliteration: Vafādāri-ye u be dustān-ash zabānzad bud.
exampleEnglish: His loyalty to his friends was well known.

exampleFarsi: خیانت دوستش او را به شدت شکست.
exampleTransliteration: Khiyānat-e dust-ash u rā be sheddat shekast.
exampleEnglish: His friend's betrayal broke him deeply.

exampleFarsi: پشیمانی از تصمیمش تا سال‌ها همراهش بود.
exampleTransliteration: Pashimāni az tasmim-ash tā sāl-hā hamrāh-ash bud.
exampleEnglish: Remorse over his decision stayed with him for years.

exampleFarsi: او تصمیم به توبه از گذشته‌اش گرفت.
exampleTransliteration: U tasmim be towbe az gozashte-ash gereft.
exampleEnglish: He decided to repent for his past.

exampleFarsi: او راه رستگاری را در سادگی یافت.
exampleTransliteration: U rāh-e rastegāri rā dar sādegi yāft.
exampleEnglish: He found the path to salvation in simplicity.

exampleFarsi: سال‌های گمراهی او سرانجام به پایان رسید.
exampleTransliteration: Sāl-hā-ye gomrāhi-ye u saranjām be pāyān resid.
exampleEnglish: His years of being lost finally came to an end.

exampleFarsi: سرگشتگی در چشمانش کاملاً پیدا بود.
exampleTransliteration: Sargashtegi dar cheshmān-ash kāmelan peydā bud.
exampleEnglish: Bewilderment was clearly visible in his eyes.

exampleFarsi: بی‌تابی برای شنیدن خبر او را از پا انداخته بود.
exampleTransliteration: Bitābi barāye shenidan-e khabar u rā az pā andākhte bud.
exampleEnglish: Restlessness to hear the news had worn her out.

exampleFarsi: دیگر طاقت این همه انتظار را نداشت.
exampleTransliteration: Digar tāqat-e in hame entezār rā nadāsht.
exampleEnglish: He no longer had the patience for so much waiting.

exampleFarsi: تحمل درد او واقعاً تحسین‌برانگیز بود.
exampleTransliteration: Tahammol-e dard-e u vāqe'an tahsin-barangiz bud.
exampleEnglish: His endurance of pain was truly admirable.

exampleFarsi: غفلت او باعث از دست رفتن فرصت شد.
exampleTransliteration: Ghaflat-e u bā'es-e az dast raftan-e forsat shod.
exampleEnglish: His negligence caused the opportunity to be lost.

exampleFarsi: هوشیاری‌اش در آن لحظه‌ی خطرناک نجاتش داد.
exampleTransliteration: Hushyāri-ash dar ān lahze-ye khatarnāk nejāt-ash dād.
exampleEnglish: His alertness in that dangerous moment saved him.
The radiance of his eyes shone in the darkness.

exampleFarsi: پندار او با واقعیت فاصله داشت.
exampleTransliteration: Pendār-e u bā vāqe'iyat fāseleh dāsht.
exampleEnglish: His notion was far from reality.

exampleFarsi: آن احساس چیزی جز یک توهم نبود.
exampleTransliteration: Ān ehsās chizi joz yek tavahhom nabud.
exampleEnglish: That feeling was nothing but an illusion.

exampleFarsi: باید با واقعیت زندگی کنار بیایی.
exampleTransliteration: Bāyad bā vāqe'iyat-e zendegi kenār biyāyi.
exampleEnglish: You must come to terms with the reality of life.

exampleFarsi: او با یقین کامل صحبت می‌کرد.
exampleTransliteration: U bā yaqin-e kāmel sohbat mikard.

exampleFarsi: او از ریا و تظاهر بیزار بود.
exampleTransliteration: U az riyā va tazāhor bizār bud.

exampleFarsi: تظاهر به خوشحالی برایش سخت بود.
exampleTransliteration: Tazāhor be khoshhāli barāyash sakht bud.
exampleEnglish: Pretending to be happy was hard for her.

exampleFarsi: اصالت این فرش در طرح‌های دست‌بافش مشخص است.
exampleTransliteration: Asālat-e in farsh dar tarh-hā-ye dast-bāfash moshakhas ast.
exampleEnglish: The authenticity of this carpet is evident in its handwoven patterns.

exampleFarsi: غرابت آن داستان همه را کنجکاو کرد.
exampleTransliteration: Gharābat-e ān dāstān hame rā konjkāv kard.
exampleEnglish: The strangeness of that story made everyone curious.

exampleFarsi: آشنایی آن‌ها به سال‌های دانشگاه برمی‌گشت.
exampleTransliteration: Āshenāyi-ye ānhā be sāl-hā-ye dāneshgāh barmigasht.
exampleEnglish: Their acquaintance dated back to their university years.

exampleFarsi: احساس بیگانگی در شهر جدید رهایش نمی‌کرد.
exampleTransliteration: Ehsās-e bigānegi dar shahr-e jadid rahā-ash nemikard.
exampleEnglish: A feeling of alienation in the new city wouldn't leave him.

exampleFarsi: دلزدگی از کارش او را به فکر تغییر انداخت.
exampleTransliteration: Delzadegi az kār-ash u rā be fekr-e taghiir andākht.
exampleEnglish: Disillusionment with his job made him think about change.

exampleFarsi: سرخوردگی از شکست او را ساکت کرده بود.
exampleTransliteration: Sarkhordegi az shekast u rā sāket karde bud.
exampleEnglish: Frustration from the defeat had silenced him.

exampleFarsi: ناامیدی اجازه نمی‌داد دوباره تلاش کند.
exampleTransliteration: Nā-omidi ejāzeh nemidād dobāreh talāsh konad.
exampleEnglish: Hopelessness wouldn't let him try again.

exampleFarsi: اسب سرکش کنترل سوارکار را از دست او خارج کرد.
exampleTransliteration: Asb-e sarkesh kontrol-e savārkār rā az dast-e u khārej kard.
exampleEnglish: The unruly horse threw off its rider's control.
